note: B34-DEF-014. Every entry here is a documented, evidence-based exception for a build/dev-tool-only advisory that npm's severity label alone would otherwise flag as release-blocking. Removing a package from this file re-enables a hard failure for it. Adding a package here requires the same evidence standard: confirmed dependency path (npm explain) AND a grep of app/components/services/hooks/contexts/lib/supabase/functions confirming no direct import from shipped source.

shell-quote.resolution: npm 'overrides' pins shell-quote to ^1.10.0, removing it from the resolved graph entirely (was react-devtools-core@6.1.5 -> shell-quote@1.8.3). No Expo/React Native/React version change required.

exceptions.reachability: Expo CLI code-signing / Metro bundler toolchain. Runs only during Expo CLI development, prebuild, code-signing, and bundling operations; never ships inside the compiled Hermes bytecode delivered to a device.
exceptions.evidence: npm explain resolves @expo/code-signing-certificates@0.0.6 and node-forge@1.4.0 only through expo@54.0.37 -> @expo/cli@54.0.27 (node-forge is also a dependency of the certificate helper); zero direct imports or source mentions from app/components/services/hooks/contexts/lib/supabase/functions. npm audit reports GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv for node-forge <=1.4.0; the 2026-10-02 registry latest is still 1.4.0, so no non-breaking patched node-forge release exists.
exceptions.fixAvailable: npm audit offers only an Expo semver-major change; node-forge latest remains affected. Track for the scheduled Expo SDK alignment rather than bypassing the locked SDK 54 authority.

exceptions.reachability: CVE-2026-93687 is in braces pattern expansion. In this locked tree every path to braces is through micromatch beneath Jest or Metro/React Native CLI build/test tooling; braces is not part of the shipped Hermes application runtime. npm audit propagates the leaf advisory severity up through those aggregate parent packages, including the runtime react-native package, even though the vulnerable path under react-native is its bundled CLI/Jest toolchain.
exceptions.evidence: Lockfile paths include react-native -> @react-native/community-cli-plugin -> metro-file-map -> micromatch -> braces; react-native -> babel-jest -> @jest/transform -> micromatch/jest-haste-map -> braces; and react-native -> jest-environment-node -> @jest/environment/@jest/fake-timers -> jest-message-util -> micromatch -> braces. No shipped source directly imports braces or the Jest/Metro aggregate packages. GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm affects braces <=3.0.3 and, as of 2026-10-04, has no patched release. The gate accepts an aggregate parent only when its npm-audit `via` graph resolves exclusively to this approved leaf and that parent is explicitly listed here; a direct high/critical advisory on react-native or any aggregate parent still fails closed.
exceptions.fixAvailable: No patched braces release exists as of 2026-10-04. Track upstream; remove this exception once a patched braces version is available in the governed Expo/React Native dependency graph.
